description: This source file defines the 'PaymentGatewayServices' class, providing methods for handling payment processes such as authorization, capture, release, and refund within the OFBiz framework. It includes logic for interacting with payment processors, managing payment preferences, and processing various payment-related transactions.

classes.name: PaymentGatewayServices
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing payment authorization, capture, release, and refund processes, integrating with external payment processors within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: authOrderPaymentPreference
methods.description: Authorizes a specific payment preference for an order, updating status and processing the payment through external services.

methods.name: authOrderPayments
methods.description: Handles authorization of all payment preferences for an order, supporting re-authentication scenarios.

methods.name: releaseOrderPayments
methods.description: Releases or voids payment authorizations for an order's payment preferences.

methods.name: processReleaseResult
methods.description: Processes the outcome of a release operation, updating records and handling errors.

methods.name: capturePaymentsByInvoice
methods.description: Captures payment against an invoice, finalizing the payment process in the system.

methods.name: releaseOrderPaymentPreference
methods.description: Releases authorization for a specific payment preference.

methods.name: processCreditResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a credit (refund) operation, updating payment preferences and related records.

methods.name: refundOrderPaymentPreference
methods.description: Handles refunding a specific payment preference for an order, interacting with the payment gateway and updating order/payment states.

methods.name: refundPayment
methods.description: Processes a refund for a payment preference, including retrieving related order data, calling the refund service, and processing the result.

methods.name: processRefundResult
methods.description: Creates and saves a PaymentGatewayResponse record for a refund, including associated messages, and updates payment preference status if refunded.

methods.name: retryFailedOrderAuth
methods.description: Re-tries authorization for an order that previously failed, updating order status based on the processor response.

methods.name: retryFailedAuths
methods.description: Re-attempts authorization for all order payment preferences marked as not authorized, processing asynchronously.

methods.name: retryFailedAuthNsfs
methods.description: Re-attempts authorization for NSF (insufficient funds) order payment preferences older than a week.

methods.name: getCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the latest capture transaction related to a specific order payment preference.

methods.name: getAuthTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent authorization or reauthorization transaction for a payment preference.

methods.name: getAuthTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves all authorization or reauthorization transactions for a payment preference.

methods.name: getAuthTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the latest authorization transaction for a payment preference.

methods.name: checkAuthValidity
methods.description: Checks whether an authorization is still valid based on transaction age and card type specific re-auth periods.

methods.name: savePgr
methods.description: Persists a PaymentGatewayResponse object and ensures rollback support.

methods.name: savePgrAndMsgs
methods.description: Persists a PaymentGatewayResponse and associated messages, with rollback support.

methods.name: savePaymentGatewayResponse
methods.description: Saves a PaymentGatewayResponse entity after truncating overly long messages.

methods.name: savePaymentGatewayResponseAndMessages
methods.description: Saves a PaymentGatewayResponse and multiple associated message entities.

methods.name: processManualCcAuth
methods.description: Performs manual credit card authorization, including security checks, credit card validation, and calling the external auth service.

methods.name: processManualCcTx
methods.description: Performs a manual credit card transaction (auth or capture), preparing request context, calling the corresponding service, and handling responses.

methods.name: verifyCreditCard
methods.description: Verifies a credit card via an external service, with optional authorization amount based on store settings.

methods.name: testProcessor
methods.description: Mock payment processor: declines all orders under 100; approves >= 100.

methods.name: testProcessorWithCapture
methods.description: Mock processor: similar to testProcessor, with additional capture result fields.

methods.name: testRandomAuthorize
methods.description: Simulates random authorization success/failure for testing.

methods.name: alwaysApproveProcessor
methods.description: Always approve payment responses for testing.

methods.name: alwaysApproveWithCapture
methods.description: Always approve and capture responses for testing.

methods.name: alwaysDeclineProcessor
methods.description: Always decline payment responses for testing.

methods.name: alwaysNsfProcessor
methods.description: Always simulate NSF (insufficient funds) for testing.

methods.name: alwaysBadExpireProcessor
methods.description: Always simulate bad expiration date error.

methods.name: badExpireEvenProcessor
methods.description: Simulates expiration date errors based on even last digit of expiry date.

methods.name: alwaysBadCardNumberProcessor
methods.description: Always simulate bad card number error.

methods.name: alwaysFailProcessor
methods.description: Always return a failure response.

methods.name: testRelease
methods.description: Simulate a successful release of a payment.

methods.name: testCapture
methods.description: Simulate a successful capture.

methods.name: testCCProcessorCaptureAlwaysDecline
methods.description: Test service that always declines capture attempts on credit cards, emulating a payment processor response for testing purposes.

methods.name: testCaptureWithReAuth
methods.description: Simulates capture with a delay condition, re-authenticating if the previous authorization is recent, for testing capture and re-auth flow.

methods.name: testRefund
methods.description: Simulate a successful refund process, returning a success response with a timestamp.

methods.name: testRefundFailure
methods.description: Simulate a failed refund process, returning a failure response with a timestamp.

methods.name: getPaymentCustomMethod
methods.description: Retrieve a custom payment method service name by customMethodId from the database.

methods.name: isReplacementOrder
methods.description: Determine if the order header indicates a replacement order based on related data.
